sources.excerpt: January 4, 2024 - On Friday, December 29th the national debt hit $34 trillion.

reasoning: According to official data from the U.S. Department of the Treasury and reports from the House Budget Committee, the United States national debt (Total Public Debt Outstanding) officially surpassed $34 trillion on December 29, 2023. By early 2024, the debt had risen further to over $34.4 trillion, and it continues to exceed this milestone.
title: US federal debt exceeds $34 trillion
